draft.title: PosterPro Privacy Policy
draft.summary: A clear policy page covering marketplace data use, operator account handling, and support expectations.

hero.title: Privacy policy for marketplace operations
hero.body: Explain how the deployment handles operator accounts, marketplace data, listing content, and support workflows.

blocks.html:
PosterPro stores the data required to help operators prepare, review, publish, and maintain marketplace listings. That can include listing text, images, workflow activity, marketplace account metadata, and authenticated tokens where a connector requires them.

The self-hosting operator is responsible for tailoring this policy so it matches the deployment, the connected marketplaces, and the team workflows that actually run in production.

Use this page as the public source of truth for what data is collected, why it is processed, and who controls that data in your environment.

items.title: Data used for listings
items.body: Document the listing content, media, pricing, and inventory metadata your team stores in PosterPro.

items.title: Connected account data
items.body: Explain how OAuth tokens, session payloads, and marketplace account identifiers are retained and refreshed.

items.title: Operator responsibility
items.body: State clearly that the self-hosting team owns final policy language, retention rules, and customer-facing notices.

draft.title: PosterPro Trust Center
draft.summary: A public overview of account-connect posture, workflow controls, and operational readiness.

hero.title: A clean trust center for marketplace teams
hero.body: Show how operators connect accounts, how listings move through review, and what support standards the deployment follows.

items.title: Centralized workflow
items.body: Listings, approval queues, marketplace connections, and automation settings are managed from one operator workspace.

items.title: Visible account handoffs
items.body: OAuth and browser-assisted connection flows are exposed through explicit status pages instead of generic redirects.

items.title: Admin-owned controls
items.body: Themes, hosted pages, and channel rules can be managed inside the same backend without a second CMS stack.

blocks.html:
Use this page to describe security posture, escalation paths, support hours, workflow review checkpoints, and what a marketplace operator should expect during setup.

For self-hosted installations, this page is also the right place to explain who administers the deployment and how account access is provisioned or removed.

blocks.title: Need a guided setup path?
blocks.body: Pair the trust center with a simple onboarding page so account owners can move from confidence to action without leaving the hosted CMS flow.

draft.title: Get Started With PosterPro
draft.summary: A guided onboarding page that explains the account setup flow before an operator signs in.

hero.title: Start with a predictable setup workflow
hero.body: Walk a new operator through sign-in, marketplace connection, and the first review steps before they enter the live workspace.

items: Sign in with the operator account or invite issued by your team.
Connect the required marketplace accounts or complete any browser-assisted login steps.
Review the draft workflow, pricing posture, and publishing approvals before going live.

items.title: Preflight before publish
items.body: Explain what needs to be configured before drafts can move into queueing or live publication.

items.title: Clear role boundaries
items.body: Tell operators which actions are automated, which remain manual, and where human approval is still required.

items.title: Reusable onboarding shell
items.body: This page can be tailored for customers, internal operators, or partner teams without spinning up a separate site.

draft.title: eBay Connection Complete
draft.summary: Success page shown when eBay returns the operator to PosterPro after approval.

hero.title: Authorization approved
hero.body: PosterPro is finishing the eBay account connection and syncing the operator workspace.

items: PosterPro exchanges the authorization response for account tokens.
The operator workspace refreshes the connection state and stores the linked seller account details.
If the connection does not appear, return to Settings and retry the OAuth flow from the eBay panel.

draft.title: eBay Access Declined
draft.summary: Fallback page shown when the operator cancels or declines eBay authorization.

hero.title: Authorization was canceled
hero.body: Return to PosterPro when you are ready to restart the eBay connection workflow.

blocks.html:
The authorization request ended before PosterPro could finish connecting the eBay account.

Return to Settings to start the connection again after confirming you are signed in to the correct seller account.

blocks.title: Ready to try again?
blocks.body: Restart the connection flow from the eBay settings panel once the operator is back in the correct account context.
